title: ATEN variable crosspoints
problem: Crosspoint source and destination fields do not accept Companion variables.
acceptance: Resolve both variables and send exactly SS 03,12; reject invalid ports without sending; preserve numeric options and profile recall.
repair: Variable-enabled text fields with asynchronous interpolation and integer/range validation.

verification.limitations: Action-contract tests use a Companion test double; transport and hardware behavior are unverified.
verification.ownerCheck: Install the test package in a separate Companion setup; record Companion version, matrix model and firmware; verify variable routing, numeric routing and profile recall; return logs and observed routes.
